en: A multi-view color postcard featuring various landmarks and street scenes from the city of Pécs. The front shows a collage: a road with a railing and the towers of a cathedral in the distance, historic buildings around a central monument in a square, garden views with sculptures and the façade of a cathedral, an Ottoman-era mosque with a green dome, outdoor cafés, and a decorative close-up detail. At the top is the word 'PÉCS' over a tricolor background resembling the Hungarian flag and the outline map of Hungary. The back is a standard unused postcard layout with a vertical publisher imprint and a barcode.
